invariants.rule:
Baseplane owns packed sequence representation, validity-aware low-level predicates, portable/prepared sequence programs, CPU/SIMD/CUDA execution, explicit residency, compact masks/events, generic segments, and scalar references. Cellerator owns the shared domain/order/identity/operand ABI, relation structures, runtime integration, numerical interpretation, fusion, planning, learned/mechanistic state, and partition policy. CelleraTorch is optional. CellShard remains read-only and parked. Experimental clarification for experiments/cuda_lab only: temporary local floating arithmetic, candidate grouping and conditional sequence-representation kernels are allowed to test the new hypothesis; they do not acquire shared numerical/ABI ownership or authorize edits in Cellerator, CelleraTorch, GlassHelix or CellShard.
Moonshot amendment (2026-10-02; governs contrary restrictions only within this scope): For BP-MOON-RUN-1 in experiments/moonshot, Baseplane owns exact sequence grounding, validity, provenance, sequence-to-effect generation and sequence-specific representation/routing. Cellerator owns shared numerical/ABI/planning capability and experimental learned or parameterized operators from inception under independent CE-MOON tasks. General numerical seed code is split into its Cellerator provider, not duplicated. No Baseplane task acquires another repository scope; GlassHelix and CellShard remain outside this campaign.

Do not add sequence file parsers, genome/motif databases, IUPAC core parsing, PWM/ontology policy, AnnData/HDF5/CSPACK ownership, training/autograd in Baseplane, dense per-base embeddings, unrestricted GPU VM, NVRTC first path, dynamic parallelism, cooperative-grid baseline, Tensor Core Boolean claims, broad reorganization, or CP-BP matrix types. Scoped exception authorized by the 2026-09-28 CUDA prototyping request: experiments/cuda_lab may contain isolated small parameterized floating-point inference probes and online routing/hierarchy tests. No production API, trainer/autograd framework, dense genome-token model, or unrestricted runtime is authorized by this exception.
Moonshot amendment (2026-10-02; governs contrary restrictions only within this scope): For the isolated BP-MOON workshop, bounded finite-state interpreters, persistent/cohort experiments, parameterized inference, tensor arithmetic and learned-to-instruction consumers are permitted. Toy trainers and general learned/numerical operators belong to the paired Cellerator research scope. No unrestricted VM, general training framework, dense genome-token prerequisite, causal claim or unrelated reorganization is authorized. This extends the isolated research exception to experiments/moonshot without changing production contracts.

Measure packed direct versus resident planes, direct allowed masks versus capped exact expansion, four multi-motif mappings, current versus shuffle count reduction, event mask versus records by density, stable versus unordered output, halo versus continuation, and lowered CUDA versus interpreter. Graphs/persistent kernels/NVRTC/discrete-program learning remain post-evidence.
Moonshot amendment (2026-10-02; governs contrary restrictions only within this scope): BP-MOON catalogue implementation does not require prior speedup evidence. Small semantic, capacity and synchronization probes support experimentation; existing required gates remain required unless explicitly revised. Production promotion, benchmarking, large training and multi-GPU qualification remain separate Q01-Q05 work. Existing measured failures remain evidence, not a blanket prohibition on different hypotheses.

Stop and hand off/block with exact evidence on unidentified dirty owned files, overlapping live lease, missing/frozen-interface mismatch, checkpoint/base-HEAD drift, absent resource, ownership contradiction, stable exact API break, missing CPU oracle, occupied CMake seam, material plan/code divergence, contaminated benchmark, unexplained sanitizer finding, or optional branch without activation evidence.
Moonshot amendment (2026-10-02; governs contrary restrictions only within this scope): For BP-MOON, stop for unsafe resources, ownership conflicts, invalid assumptions, unsupported instructions or the preserved identity/capacity/frozen-interface safeguards. Lack of a speedup, an unproven research hypothesis or an unstable isolated experimental API alone is not a stop condition. The user-authorized moonshot catalogue supplies activation evidence for isolated ideas only.
